editorial_examples.english: The meadows turn green again in spring.
editorial_examples.note: The candidate used grünen as an inflected adjective in grünen Tee, not as the verb lemma. Replaced it with a verbal example.

editorial_examples.note: Improved the English and German phrasing for a natural example of the masculine noun Student.

editorial_examples.english: The desired result was achieved.
editorial_examples.note: The candidate used gewünscht as part of the verb phrase sich etwas wünschen; this entry is the adjective. Replaced it with attributive adjective use.
